body.statement: The relation \(\prec_S\) is a strict partial order and equals the ancestral relations shared by every full joint component-aligned Gaussian completion of \(\mathcal O_S\). It is computable by intersecting transitive closures of the union support graphs \(G_T\) over distinct \(T\in\Theta_S(\mathcal O_S)\), so it is invariant to duplicate inducing orders.
body.justification: The poset reports the causal ordering content that is identified even when the full order is not.
body.gap: The full-pair anchor targets a recovered order; no cited result extracts the invariant ancestral content of a partial-calibration coefficient set.
body.consumer: Downstream pathway analyses can restrict claims to ancestral relations shared by all compatible view-specific repeated-measurement mechanisms.
